meta.name: content-migration
meta.description: Move content between platforms, domains, or URL structures while preserving SEO equity, user bookmarks, and integrations. Use this skill when planning a CMS migration, replatforming, consolidating sites, changing URL structures, or merging content from multiple sources. Triggers on content migration, replatform, CMS migration, domain migration, URL restructure, redirect map, site merge, content consolidation, migration plan, post-migration drop. Also triggers when planning a launch that involves moving existing content.

copy.tagline: 跨平台搬移内容,保住搜索排名和书签
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正在计划网站改版或换后台,担心旧链接失效和排名下跌。
copy.tagline_en: Move content across platforms without losing search rankings or bookmarks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning a site redesign or CMS switch and worry about broken links and lost rankings.
